card.name: Comma after addiction in opioid warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after the word "addiction" in the phrase "addiction, abuse, and misuse" in opioid labels. It also fires on a comma after a clause like "excreted by the kidney" in geriatric use text.

modes.label: Addiction, abuse, misuse
modes.description: Comma following "Addiction" at the start of the opioid risk triad.
modes.example: Assess each patient’s risk for opioid addiction<<,>> abuse, or misuse prior to prescribing AP

modes.label: Geriatric kidney clause
modes.description: Comma after "excreted by the kidney" before "and the risk of toxic reactions".
modes.example: Geriatric Use This drug is known to be substantially excreted by the kidney<<,>> and the risk of toxic reactions to this

modes.label: Web page list comma
modes.description: Comma after a project name in a web page navigation line.
modes.example: CitEc Project<<,>> subscribe to its RSS feed for this item

card.plain: It marks the comma in the stock opioid phrase "addiction, abuse, and misuse", where the next words are highly predictable.
